# IPA Validation Conditions

Named conditions that decide where IPA rules apply. They are defined in [rulesets/functions/utils/conditions](https://github.com/mongodb/openapi/tree/main/tools/spectral/ipa/rulesets/functions/utils/conditions) and used by rules built with `defineRule`. Only conditions used by at least one rule are listed.
